hook_line: INDIAN STARTUP MIRAQULES WINS SLINGSHOT 2026 GRAND PRIZE IN SINGAPORE

hook_stat.sub: Startups beaten in the global competition

diaspora_bullets: The win plugs an Indian medtech into Singapore hospital and investor networks
A marker for Indian clinician-founders and health-tech investors in Singapore and the US
news_summary: Indian medtech Miraqules MedSolutions was named Grand Winner of SLINGSHOT 2026, Enterprise Singapore's global deep-tech pitching competition, at the Grand Finals during SWITCH in Singapore on October 29.
payoff: Clinical validation and regulatory approval are still ahead before StopBleed can be sold.
